title: Lever bench, assembled
note: The rig with a specimen bolted on edge, the gauge arm on top and the hanger on the load bolt. The specimen's two bolts and the load bolt are fastens, so they are drawn, checked and listed; the gauge arm's two bolts are not yet (their nuts sit in side slots the check does not read as a nut's seat). Swap the specimen's object for lever-bar, lever-plate or lever:both.
